title: Storybound document
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/documents/<path>.json. The text lives in the resource pack: assets/<ns>/storybound/texts/<lang>/<content path>.sbt.

icon.description: Dev mode only: the item this node shows on the editor's canvases (an item id, e.g. minecraft:compass). The game does not read it; without it, the kind's own item.

kind.description: book: two-page spread with page turning; scroll, note, letter, contract: one scrolling column.

content.description: The .sbt text id; defaults to the document id.

style.description: assets/<ns>/storybound/styles/<id>.json; defaults by kind: book_leather, scroll, note_torn, parchment.

category.description: Journal section; defaults by kind: books, scrolls, notes, letters, contracts. Name: '<ns>.journal.category.<path>'.

on_read.description: Runs on the player's first read only; never sent to clients.

loot.description: Where this document can appear as loot in the world (chests in structures, specific loot tables, or mob drops). Evaluated dynamically on reload; never sent to clients.

custom_model_data.description: Applied to the item when issued; pair with an override in the item model.

quest.description: The quest the contract gives: started on the first read, before on_read.

conditions.description: Printed in bold under the contract's text: what is to be done.

reward.description: Printed under the contract's text: what it pays.

hint.description: Printed in italics under the contract's text: a hint where to start.

tables.description: Specific loot tables (e.g. minecraft:chests/abandoned_mineshaft or minecraft:entities/pillager). Empty: matches any chest loot table.

dimension.description: Only in this dimension (empty: any dimension).

biome.description: Only in these biomes: an id, a #tag, or a list.

structure.description: Only inside these structures: an id, a #tag, or a list.

once.description: none: can appear repeatedly. player: at most once per player. world: at most once in the whole world.

conditions.description: Optional story conditions checked for the player opening the chest or killing the mob.
